scripts.build: pnpm build:app && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','build/license_en.txt')" && electron-builder --publish never && electron-rebuild -f -o uiohook-napi
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worklet.json
scripts.build:app: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build/.gen/bundled-desktop.json',{force:true})" && electron-vite build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --bundled build/.gen/bundled-desktop.json --with-prod --out build/.gen/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt && node scripts/check-main-bundle.mjs && node scripts/check-mail-engine.mjs
scripts.build:web: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build/.gen/bundled-web.json',{force:true})" && vite build --config vite.web.config.ts --mode web && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --bundled build/.gen/bundled-web.json --out dist-web/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','dist-web/LICENSE.txt');f.copyFileSync('../../NOTICE','dist-web/NOTICE.txt');f.copyFileSync('../../COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md','dist-web/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.txt')" && node scripts/check-web-bundle.mjs
scripts.e2e:visual: pnpm build:app && pnpm build:web && playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts
scripts.e2e:visual:mail: CALABA_MAIL_MOCK=1 pnpm build:app && playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts --project mail-dark-960
scripts.e2e:visual:billing: VITE_BILLING_MOCK=1 pnpm build:web && playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts -g billing
scripts.e2e:visual:billing:update: VITE_BILLING_MOCK=1 pnpm build:web && playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts -g billing --update-snapshots=all
scripts.e2e:visual:update: pnpm build:app && pnpm build:web && playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts --update-snapshots=all
